decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of permission P/2010/2837 aka 00580/AG/P1 approved 13/12/2010.
Reason: To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990).
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered 7672/12, 7672/15, 7672/16, 7672/18, Design & Access Statement received 30/09/2010 and 7672/13A, 7672/17A received 06/10/2010 and 7672/17D received 02/11/2010 and Travel Plan former Solus Site approved 31st January 2011 and Cover letter dated 17th January 2025, Site Location Plan received 10th February 2025 and Noise Impact Assessment prepared by Nova Acoustics received 12th September 2025 and 2024/071-01 Existing Site Plan, 2024/071-02 Proposed Site Plan, J7/01166 12K Envirofence Fence � 2.5m high, 06 J7/04172 Section Fencing System � Various Heights  received 16th October 2025 and Noise Management Plan prepared by Mialex dated October 2025 received 17th October 2025 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In order not to prejudice the council's standards for provision of car parking spaces and service facilities in accordance with policies T.1.4 Car and Cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments of the Hounslow UDP.
Condition : 4 - No machinery shall be operated, no process shall be carried out and no deliveries taken at or despatched from the site outside the following times 07:00-19:00 Monday-Friday, 08:00-18:00 Saturdays, and 10:00-16:00 on Sundays and Bank/Public Holidays.
Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties.
Condition : 5 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including space for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing SK-002A and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose (including any additional external storage).
Reason: In order to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the adjacent highway and the premises, and in the interests of road safety available in accordance with policy ENV.B.1.1 New development and policy T1.4 Car and Cycle Parking and servicing facilities for developments and T4.4 Road safety.
Condition : 6 - The final version of the submitted Noise Management Plan by MIALEX, dated October 2025 � received 17th October 2025, and the 2.5m high acoustic fencing detailed in approved drawings 2024/071-01 Existing Site Plan, 2024/071-02 Proposed Site Plan, J7/01166 12K Envirofence Fence � 2.5m high, 06 J7/04172 Section Fencing System � Various Heights � received 16th October 2025 shall be implemented prior to the extended hours coming into use and all steps to mitigate noise shall be adhered to at all times while the site is in operation. Where necessary, additional mitigation measures shall be implemented to achieve the post mitigation sound levels detailed in Figure 3 (Titled: Specific Sound Level Map), page 16 of the Nova Acoustics Noise Impact Assessment.
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise.
Condition : 7 - All external lighting shall be directed downwards and not exceed the current lux levels of the existing external lights. Any additional external lighting would require prior approval in writing from the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties.
Condition : 8 - The approved development shall be undertaken and maintained in accordance with the Travel Plan approved under conditions application P/2010/3560 AKA 00580/AG/P1(8) approved 31st January 2011.
Reason: To promote sustainable transport models.
Condition : 9 - Noise from uses and activities within the building/development site shall not exceed the criteria of BS8233:2014 at neighbouring noise sensitive/habitable rooms and private external amenity spaces. 
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) and condition 4 (hours of operation) to erect a 2.5m high timber acoustic fence along the northern boundary and to extend the hours of operation following planning permission P/2010/2837 (00580/AG/P1) dated 13/12/2010 for the change of use from B2 to flexible B2 and B8 uses with ancillary offices (amended description)
